title: VP of Product Development

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: Mimaki's explicit positioning around 'industry's best outdoor color durability' and partnership with 3M's MCS Warranty Program shows product differentiation is core to their competitive strategy. This role owns the product roadmap and decides which consumables, accessories, and solutions get bundled or recommended with their printer systems. Tedlar directly enables them to strengthen their outdoor durability claims, extend warranty coverage, reduce customer warranty claims from fading/cracking, and differentiate their eco-solvent and UV printer offerings in a competitive market. With Mimaki winning 2025 Pinnacle Awards and actively launching new models like the JV200 Series, the VP Product Development would be measured on market differentiation, customer satisfaction scores, and warranty claim reduction—all areas where Tedlar's 12-20+ year lifespan and UV protection provide quantifiable advantage. Given Mimaki's focus on outdoor applications and vehicle wraps, recommending Tedlar as the premium overlaminate solution would directly support their premium positioning and could become a competitive moat.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: This VP owns Mimaki's product roadmap and strategy for eco-solvent and UV printer systems. They decide which consumables, accessories, and recommended solutions get bundled with printer offerings or endorsed in training programs across Mimaki's five North American training centers. They likely report to a President or General Manager and oversee technical product managers and application engineers. Given Mimaki's emphasis on outdoor durability claims and their 3M MCS Warranty Program partnership, this role owns decisions about which protective films and overlaminates Mimaki recommends or co-markets with their JV200 Series and other outdoor-focused printer lines.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: Three Tedlar use cases directly strengthen Mimaki's product strategy: (1) Vehicle Wraps & Fleet Graphics—Tedlar's graffiti resistance and 20+ year outdoor lifespan reduce warranty callbacks for Mimaki's eco-solvent printer customers in the vehicle wrap market, directly supporting Mimaki's 'best outdoor color durability' positioning. (2) Signs & Outdoor Graphics—Tedlar's UV protection prevents yellowing, fading, and cracking on graphics printed with Mimaki's JV200 Series, extending the lifespan of customer installations and reducing replacement frequency. (3) Architectural Graphics—For large-format architectural applications printed on Mimaki's UV flatbed systems, Tedlar provides weather resistance (-70°F to 230°F) and mold/mildew resistance, enabling Mimaki to compete for premium architectural projects requiring multi-decade performance guarantees. Each use case enables Mimaki to differentiate on total cost of ownership rather than just print quality or speed.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: This VP is measured on product differentiation metrics, customer satisfaction scores, warranty claim rates, and competitive win rates. Their success depends on Mimaki maintaining premium positioning in a market with aggressive low-cost competition. Warranty claims from premature UV degradation, fading, or cracking directly impact their KPIs and erode Mimaki's durability reputation. With the JFX200-1213 EX winning a 2025 Pinnacle Award, maintaining that quality reputation is critical. Tedlar solves three pain points this VP personally owns: (1) reducing warranty claim frequency and costs, (2) enabling stronger durability guarantees that close premium accounts, and (3) creating a defensible competitive moat by bundling Tedlar with Mimaki printers as a complete outdoor durability system—something competitors can't easily replicate.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: Mimaki exhibited at ISA Sign Expo April 23-25, 2025, showcasing the JV200-130 model with explicit outdoor durability messaging. They also opened a new corporate office in Flowery Branch, GA in June 2025 with an expanded showroom and warehouse, indicating investment in customer demonstrations and training. The timing is ideal because: (1) post-ISA Sign Expo, the sales and product teams are receiving direct customer feedback on durability concerns, (2) the new showroom facility creates an opportunity to demonstrate Tedlar-protected samples alongside Mimaki printers, and (3) their 25-year anniversary messaging and recent Pinnacle Award win position them to invest in premium solutions that reinforce market leadership. Additionally, their active partnership with 3M's MCS Warranty Program suggests openness to evaluating protective film solutions that extend warranty coverage.

personalization_hooks.hook: Mimaki positions the JV200 Series as delivering 'industry's best outdoor color durability' and partners with 3M MCS Warranty Program
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Acknowledge their existing durability leadership, then position Tedlar as the next evolution—enabling them to extend warranty periods beyond industry standard and offer quantifiable protection claims (no yellowing, no cracking) that competitors can't match. Frame it as strengthening their existing moat, not fixing a weakness.

personalization_hooks.hook: New Flowery Branch facility with expanded showroom opened in June 2025 for customer demonstrations and training
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Propose a side-by-side durability demonstration in their new showroom: Tedlar-protected graphics vs. standard overlaminates under accelerated UV testing. This gives them a tangible sales tool for their five training centers and creates a 'proof of concept' that their sales teams can reference when justifying premium pricing to vehicle wrap shops and signage companies.

personalization_hooks.hook: VP Product Development owns warranty claim reduction and product differentiation in a competitive market with low-cost alternatives
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Lead with the business case: Tedlar reduces warranty callbacks from UV degradation and graffiti damage, directly improving customer satisfaction scores while enabling premium pricing. Position it as a strategic product roadmap decision, not just a material swap—Mimaki becomes the only printer manufacturer offering a complete outdoor durability system with 20-year performance data.

recommended_approach: Lead with competitive differentiation and product strategy angle. Open by acknowledging Mimaki's durability leadership and recent Pinnacle Award, then frame Tedlar as a strategic enabler for their next phase of premium positioning. Avoid leading with technical specs—this VP cares about market differentiation, warranty cost reduction, and defensible competitive advantages. Propose a specific next step: arrange a showroom demonstration at their new Flowery Branch facility or discuss integrating Tedlar into their training center curriculum as a recommended overlaminate for outdoor applications.
